map.按 CAPEX、折现率、运维与年发电量计算平准化度电成本 LCOE，比较发电项目: Compute the levelized cost of electricity LCOE from CAPEX, discount rate, O&M and annual generation to compare power project economics; a pure front-end estimate to support investment judgment.
map.LCOE = 生命周期成本 / 总发电量: LCOE = life cycle cost / total generation
map.对比光伏/风电/燃机的度电成本。: Compare levelized cost of electricity for PV, wind and gas turbines.
map.折现率变化对 LCOE 的敏感度分析。: Sensitivity analysis of LCOE to discount rate changes.
map.：CAPEX 500 万元、20 年、折现率 6%、年运维 10 万元、年发电: : CAPEX 5,000,000 CNY, 20 years, discount rate 6%, annual O&M 100,000 CNY, annual generation 1.2 million kWh: CRF = 0.06·1.06²⁰/(1.06²⁰ − 1) ≈ 0.0872; LCOE = (500 × 0.0872 + 10)/120 ≈ (43.6 + 10)/120 ≈ 0.447 CNY/kWh. Note: raising the discount rate 2% pushes LCOE up markedly.

map.在同等可靠与并网条件下，LCOE 越低竞争力越强；但需结合消纳、波动性与辅助成本: With equal reliability and grid connection, a lower LCOE means stronger competitiveness; but it must be read together with curtailment, variability and ancillary costs.
map.为什么折现率影响大？: Why does the discount rate matter so much?
map.高折现率抬高远期发电现值权重低，CAPEX 回收压力大，LCOE 上升；政策利率: A high discount rate lowers the weight of future generation present value, raising pressure to recover CAPEX and pushing LCOE up; policy rates and risk premia pass through directly.
